data.body: Constraint: the agent tool-binding prefixes are validated twice and must agree. Native is_tool_binding_id (runtime/documents.rs) and the editor's isToolBindingId (src/workbench/workflowExecution.ts) both gate agent toolIds and tool-node toolId. The native-ComfyUI task taught the editor and the freeze path about comfyui.<id> but not the native catalog validator, so the Chat's saved workflow 'workflow.custom.3' was refused at Run start: "workflow node 'agent.1' agent toolIds must reference tool.<name> or mcp:<server> bindings". Fixed by accepting COMFYUI_CAPABILITY_PREFIX in is_tool_binding_id. Add a new binding prefix to BOTH predicates plus the freeze arms in service/workflow_tools.rs. Also: two test fns in the tree had no #[test] attribute and never ran (documents.rs catalog_accepts_the_standard_agent_graph..., settings_v2.rs external_agent_delegation_defaults_are_optional); both are enabled and green - check for unannotated tests after large agent edits.
